name: comp-553
title: Mixed File Upload Manager
description: A rounded upload panel collects up to six files and shows each as a row with a type icon, name, size and remove button, filling a thin progress bar while it uploads.
use: Several files of mixed types must be chosen and watched while they upload.
avoid: It caps the list at six files and 5MB each, so bulk or large uploads need edits.
a11y: Progress percentages are not announced, and the drop area has no role or label, though the input and buttons do. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a near-black page, a rounded bordered panel holds a Files (6) heading with Add files and Remove all buttons above stacked rows. Each row is a dark tile with a square file icon, a name and size, a thin progress bar, and an X at the right.
behaves: Adding files appends rows and starts each upload as a thin bar that fills beside a rising percentage. On completion the bar disappears, leaving the row; the X removes one file and Remove all clears the list.
customise: The initial file list, limits (six files, 5MB) and upload simulation are written into the source; only the demo's own copy stays fixed.
weight: light: A few rows and CSS width transitions; one timer per file while uploading.
demo: Starts with intro.zip, image-01.jpg and audio.mp3; the clip adds three PNG cover images.
issues: Input and button copy say images only, but any file type is accepted.
polishWhy: Tidy rows and clear per-file progress, but the panel is small and visually plain.
